THE FINAL PARTY AT THE PAVILION OF 2026!

We’re going out with a BIG one! Join us Saturday, September 12 as we welcome JB & The Get Down Browns to the Pavilion for the final concert of our 2026 Party at the Pavilion Summer Concert Series!

Grab your friends, bring your dancing shoes, and get ready for a night of LIVE MUSIC, DANCING, COLD BEER, WINE, and GREAT FOOD!

Saturday, September 12
Pavilion • 36 N. Main Street, Chase City
$5 Admission
Gates Open at 6 PM
Music Starts at 7 PM
Food Truck - Whiskey Wine BBQ

And a huge shoutout to our Presenting Sponsor, Southern Pine Realty Solutions, for helping make this summer concert series possible!

Don’t miss the FINAL PARTY OF THE SUMMER! Come hungry, come ready to dance, and let’s send Party at the Pavilion 2026 out in style!

Mecklenburg Masters - Chase City Chamber of Commerce Golf Tournament

  • Friday, May 1, 2026
  • 8:30 AM 3:00 PM
  • Google Calendar ICS

Mecklenburg Masters Golf Tournament

The Chase City Chamber of Commerce is excited to bring a brand-new theme to our annual golf tournament — The Masters! Join us for the Mecklenburg Masters at Mecklenburg Country Club on Friday, May 1st for a day of friendly competition, great food, and community fun on the greens.

Teams of four will enjoy a full day of golf with lunch, beverage cart service, and plenty of opportunities to show off their Masters-worthy skills. With both morning and afternoon tee times, golfers can choose the flight that works best for their team.

The $275 team entry fee includes play for four golfers, one mulligan per player, lunch, and beverages on the course. Flights will be determined by a sealed draw of front or back scores to keep the competition exciting for everyone.

Grab your team, polish up your swing, and join us for a Masters-inspired day of golf right here in Chase City!

🍂 Chase City Autumn Jubilee 2025
Mark your calendar for Saturday, September 20, 2025 and join us in Downtown Chase City for a day of fall fun! From the Car Show and Fun Run to the Scarecrow Contest, Pumpkin Chucking, and all-new activities like Laser Tag, a Bounce House, and a Caricature Artist — there’s something for everyone. Enjoy live music, delicious food trucks, family-friendly activities, and a true small-town festival atmosphere.
